column1: # Claimed coverage of the GUARDED prefix set in `commit-msg`, one row per path.
#   claim  match   = the comment claims this path IS guarded
#          nomatch = the comment claims this path is NOT guarded
#   repo   informational only. `git diff --cached --numstat` prints paths
#          relative to the repo being committed, so the regex never sees the
#          repo name — that is exactly why the three prefixes are repo-agnostic
#          and why the earlier "two Cellrix trees plus the ADRs, and nothing
#          else" wording was a claim the mechanism could not honour (K-104c).
#   basis  where the claim comes from: the comment's own words, or an explicit
#          declaration added by the K-104c correction (`@scope:` line).
